stories.title: Houthis say they attacked vessel off Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: Houthis say they attacked vessel off Saudi Arabia Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthi movement said on Monday that it had attacked a vessel off the coast of Saudi Arabia near the Red Sea port city of Yanbu. The group’s military spokesperson, Yahya Saree, made the statement in a televised speech. Saudi authorities did not immediately comment. Earlier on Monday, the UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said a tanker had been struck by an unknown projectile about 63 nautical miles west of Yanbu. UKMTO said all crew members were safe and accounted for, with no reported environmental impact. Yanbu is Saudi Arabia’s main Red Sea oil export port and has become an important route for Saudi crude ship
